review_scope: Read-only independent token-ID audit of all frozen E/R/U; no model inference or updates
finding: Qwen3 merges question-mark plus newline in jointly tokenized learning/KL prompts; generated continuations use separately tokenized prefix and suffix. Qwen3.5 official tokenizer agrees for all frozen E/R/U.
suggested_fix: Construct shared learning_prompt_ids(row) as cat(ids(base_prompt(row,row[q1])), ids(cfg[suffix])). Use those exact IDs for target_loss, R teacher/replay and R/U KL evaluations. Keep generation path and scientific case/step matrix fixed.
preservation: Archive original Qwen3 four episodes before fixed-budget rerun. Qwen3.5 IDs are already identical for all E/R/U, so no boundary-driven rerun is required.
additional_checks: Verify shared IDs equality plus answer/EOS logit alignment; compare full-forward vs cached suffix next logits on identical concatenated IDs, allowing an explicit numerical tolerance.
source_note: Root added prompt_suffix_ids while this independent tokenizer-only audit was running; at-write source hash is the repaired implementation. The archived pre-fix execution-source hash identifies the reviewed logic.
